verdict.rationale: Beamer is a SaaS changelog and in-app notification product, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint. The generic API and webhooks mention is a developer building block, not an MCP server, and the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
